thread:
Alex W: Quick update — deployed release 1.14.3 to prod at 14:03 UTC (image: redwood/inference:1.14.3). Deployer: Samir. Rolling strategy: 10% -> 50% -> 100% (30s pauses). Rollback ready: image redwood/inference:1.14.2, plan is to run `kubectl set image deployment/inference inference=redwood/inference:1.14.2 -n prod` and scale back rollout. Target watch window: 30m. Please run quick smoke checks and report.
Samir: Starting smoke suite now — health, p95 latency, embeddings sanity, and a couple of smoke prompts. Commands I'm running:
```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $RELEASE_KEY" https://api.prod.redwood.ai/v1/health
curl -sS -X POST https://api.prod.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"quick test","max_tokens":20}' | jq '.status'
```
Samir: Health endpoint 200 OK. Generate returned status OK and sample tokens look sane. p95 latency from gateway (~14:05) = 120ms, baseline is 100ms but still within alert threshold. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: rollout progress — 10% -> 50% at 14:04 UTC. No failures during canary.
Priya: Ran embeddings smoke against embedding-service (10 vectors). Cosine calc ok, similarity ranks match expected sample. Quick sample response:
`{"embedding_ok":true,"sample_similarity":0.92}`
Jordan C: Noting a small P95 blip at 14:05 — +30ms on model-serving path (GPU pod set A). No errors, just latency spike. I'll watch graphs for 10m; if >50ms sustained, we'll rollback. Also rechecked KV cache hit rate, still ~86%.
ops-monitor: Observed CPU spike on gpu-node-23 at 14:04 (82% for ~30s), recovered to 54%. No OOMs or pod restarts. Metrics link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/serve
Alex W: Thanks all. Plan: leave rollout to 100%, monitor for 30m. Samir/Jordan/Priya — keep eyes on errors (>0.1% increase) and p95. If anything breaches we revert to 1.14.2. Ping me or @deploy-bot to trigger rollback. :thumbsup:
Samir: Will keep an eye, posting any anomalies in this thread. If nothing else, I'll post a final thumbs-up at +30m.
Jordan C: +1, standing by. If I see repeated spikes I'll snapshot traces and call the rollback.
Priya: Verified a couple of production QA prompts (structured output test) — outputs match expected keys. No quick fixes needed so far.
Alex W: Final note — added a tiny config tweak to autoscaler (maxReplicas +1) in the same rollout to absorb burst. Observability alerted briefly but graphs look stable. Closing watch unless someone reports otherwise.
